name: MTT Shipping and Logistics Berhad
summary: MTT Shipping and Logistics Berhad, through its subsidiaries, engages in the shipping and logistics businesses in Malaysia. The company operates in two segments, Shipping Activities and Depot Activities. It offers container liner shipping and feeder services; ship management services, including technical, marine, and crew management, as well as procurement and vessel acquisition and registration; container storage and container-related services; and operation of chemical tankers, chartered tugs, and barges.
